options: No, we usually eat with a spoon or our hands.
People in Japan usually bow when they meet.
People in Japan bow usually when they meet.

1-1.answer: It takes place in the spring.

options: I would rather live in a village because it's peaceful.

options: We will probably use flying taxis.

1-4.answer: The tower is made of glass and steel.

options: Because I want to see the pyramids.

We need our lungs to breathe.

The stomach help us digest food.
The stomach helps us digesting food.

2-2.answer: It was raining heavily when we left school.
Suddenly the wind blew the roof off.

2-2.q: It was raining heavily when the lights ___ off.
What happened next in the storm?
options: Suddenly the wind became very strong.
We was walking home when the storm started.
We were walk home when the storm started.

2-3.answer: When you add salt, the egg floats.
The balloon gets bigger because gas goes inside it.

When you add water, the paper gets wet.

He discovered penicillin and it changed medicine.

How long have you been playing football?

I've been learning to dance for a year.

How you felt when you met him?
How did you feel when you met him?

words.ex: On the first day, I introduced myself to the new students.
My favourite hobby is drawing animals.
We have a lot in common because we both love football.
I like to chat with my friends at break time.
Sami was shy at first, but now he talks to everyone.
My new classmate sits next to me in science.

dialogue.t: Hi! I'm Layla. I'm new here.
Hi, Layla! I'm Omar. Nice to meet you.
Nice to meet you too. What do you like doing after school?
I like playing basketball and reading comics.
Me too! I love reading comics. Which ones do you read?
Mostly superhero comics. What about you? Do you play any sports?
Yes, I go swimming every Saturday.
Really? That's cool! Maybe we can go swimming together one day.

grammar.title: like + verb-ing and quick replies
grammar.ar: نستخدم like + فعل ينتهي بـ ing للتحدث عن الأشياء التي نحب فعلها، مثل: I like swimming. وللسؤال عن هوايات شخص ما نقول: What do you like doing? وعندما نوافق الشخص الآخر نقول: Me too! أما إذا تفاجأنا أو أردنا أن نُظهر الاهتمام فنقول: Really? لكي تستمر المحادثة.
examples: What do you like doing at the weekend?
I like playing video games with my brother.
I love drawing. – Me too!

words.ex: I felt nervous before my English test.
We were excited because the school trip was the next day.
My mum was proud of me when I won the race.
Hana was upset because she lost her favourite pen.
I felt embarrassed when I fell over in the playground.
Dad was worried because my little brother was ill.

dialogue.t: How was the school play yesterday?
It was great! But I felt nervous when I walked onto the stage.
Really? Why were you nervous?
Because there were so many people. My whole family was there!
I understand. How did you feel at the end?
I was really proud because I didn't forget any of my lines.
Well done! I was excited when I saw the photos online.
Thanks! Next time you should come and watch.

grammar.title: Feelings with when and because
grammar.ar: للتحدث عن مشاعرنا في الماضي نستخدم felt أو was/were + صفة الشعور، مثل: I felt happy أو I was nervous. نستخدم when لنقول متى حدث الشعور، ونستخدم because لنذكر سبب الشعور. انتبه: في الإنجليزية لا بد من وجود فعل was/were قبل الصفة، ولا نقول I nervous.
examples: I felt nervous when the teacher called my name.
I was excited because it was my birthday.
She was upset when her friend didn't call her.

words.ex: My sister and I sometimes argue about the TV.
Ali fell out with his best friend last week.
They argued in the morning, but they made up after lunch.
You should apologise if you hurt someone's feelings.
Thanks for your suggestion. I'll try it!
It isn't nice to leave someone out of a game.

dialogue.t: You look sad. What's wrong?
I fell out with Noor. She thinks I told her secret to everyone.
Oh no! Did you tell anyone?
No, I didn't! But she won't talk to me now.
Why don't you write her a short message?
That's a good idea. But what should I say?
You could tell her the truth. And maybe you should talk to her at break time too.
OK, I'll try. Thanks for your help!

grammar.title: Making suggestions
grammar.ar: لتقديم اقتراح لصديق نستخدم: Why don't you + الفعل في صيغته الأساسية؟ أو You could + الفعل أو Maybe you should + الفعل. بعد هذه التعبيرات يأتي الفعل بدون to وبدون ing، فنقول: You could call her وليس You could to call her. وعبارة Maybe you should أكثر لطفًا من You should وحدها.
examples: Why don't you say sorry to him?
You could invite her to play with you.
Maybe you should talk to your teacher.

words.ex: It was kind of you to carry my bag.
I often help out in the kitchen at home.
I shared my lunch with a friend who forgot his.
Our old neighbour lives alone, so we visit her.
We donated our old toys to children in hospital.
My brother volunteers at the animal centre.

dialogue.t: Our teacher wants us to talk about acts of kindness. Have you done anything kind this month?
Yes! I've helped my neighbour with her shopping bags.
That's really kind. Was it heavy?
A bit! What about you?
I've shared my notes with a new classmate. She was ill last week.
Nice! Have you ever volunteered anywhere?
No, I've never volunteered, but I want to help at the animal centre.
Me too! Let's ask our parents if we can go together.

grammar.title: Present perfect for experiences
grammar.ar: نستخدم المضارع التام have/has + التصريف الثالث للفعل للتحدث عن تجارب في حياتنا دون ذكر وقت محدد، مثل: I have helped my friend. ونختصر I have إلى I've. نستخدم never لنقول إننا لم نفعل الشيء أبدًا: I've never donated. وللسؤال عن تجربة نقول: Have you ever ...?
examples: I have helped my grandma in the garden.
I've never volunteered, but I want to try it.
Have you ever donated your clothes?

words.ex: Our team won the science competition.
We worked together to finish the poster.
Each student had a different task in the project.
In a good team, everyone shares ideas.
I was responsible for the drawings.
Our goal was to build the tallest tower.

dialogue.t: How did your group project go?
Really well! We worked together to make a model of a volcano.
Wow! What was your job?
My job was to paint it. Yusuf was responsible for the information cards.
Did everyone agree on everything?
Not at first, but we shared ideas and chose the best one.
That sounds like a great team.
It was! We finished on time and the teacher loved it.

grammar.title: Talking about past teamwork: to + verb
grammar.ar: للحديث عن عمل جماعي في الماضي نستخدم الماضي البسيط مثل worked وwas. نستخدم to + الفعل الأساسي لنذكر الهدف أو المهمة، مثل: We worked together to clean the classroom. ونقول My job was to + الفعل لنشرح دورنا في الفريق. لا تنسَ أن تضع to قبل الفعل في هذه الجمل.
examples: We worked together to plant trees in the school garden.
My job was to write the questions.
Our team met every day to practise.

words.ex: Can you give me some advice about my homework?
You ought to go to bed early before a test.
If you want to play better, you should practise every day.
You look tired. Why don't you take a break?
It's OK to ask for help when something is difficult.
It's always better to be honest with your friends.

dialogue.t: Can I ask you for some advice?
Of course. What's the problem?
I have a big maths test on Monday, and I don't understand fractions.
If I were you, I would ask the teacher for help tomorrow.
Good idea. But I'm a bit shy.
Don't worry. You ought to practise with me after school too.
Really? That would be great!
Sure! And you ought to take a break sometimes. Don't study all night!

grammar.title: Giving advice: If I were you / ought to
grammar.ar: لتقديم نصيحة نقول: If I were you, I would + الفعل الأساسي، ومعناها: لو كنت مكانك لفعلت كذا. لاحظ أننا نستخدم were وليس was مع I في هذا التعبير. ويمكننا أيضًا استخدام ought to + الفعل الأساسي، وهي تشبه should في المعنى.
examples: If I were you, I would tell your parents.
You ought to drink more water when you play sport.
If I were you, I wouldn't worry about it.

words.ex: I love learning about the culture of other countries.
It is a custom in Saudi Arabia to serve guests coffee and dates.
My grandfather wears traditional clothes every day.
We usually greet our teachers with a smile.
It is polite to say thank you when someone helps you.
In Japan, people bow when they meet someone.

dialogue.t: I watched a video about Japan yesterday. Their customs are really interesting!
Really? What do people do there?
In Japan people usually bow when they meet, but in Saudi Arabia we shake hands.
That's different! What about food?
In Japan people usually eat with chopsticks, but in Saudi Arabia we often eat with a spoon or our right hand.
And do they take off their shoes at home?
Yes, they always do. We usually take off our shoes at home too!
So some customs are different, and some are the same. Cool!

grammar.title: Present simple for customs + but
grammar.ar: نستخدم المضارع البسيط (Present Simple) للحديث عن العادات والأشياء التي يفعلها الناس دائمًا أو عادةً. نضع ظروف التكرار مثل usually وoften وalways قبل الفعل الرئيسي. ونستخدم كلمة but لربط جملتين ومقارنة شيئين مختلفين.
examples: In Japan people usually bow, but in Saudi Arabia we shake hands.
In Italy people often eat pasta, but in Saudi Arabia we often eat kabsa.
In the UK people usually drink tea with milk, but we drink it with mint.

words.ex: The lantern festival is very beautiful at night.
The festival takes place every year in spring.
We celebrate Eid with our whole family.
People decorate their houses with lights.
We watched the fireworks from the roof.
My little sister made a red paper lantern.

dialogue.t: Can you tell me about a festival in your country?
Sure! Eid al-Fitr is my favourite. It takes place at the end of Ramadan.
How long does it last?
It usually lasts three days. People celebrate by visiting family and wearing new clothes.
Do children get presents?
Yes! Adults give children money called eidiya. Some cities also have fireworks.
That sounds fun. In China, people celebrate New Year by giving red envelopes too!
Really? That's very similar to our eidiya!

grammar.title: Describing festivals: take place / celebrate by + -ing
grammar.ar: نستخدم It takes place in/on للحديث عن مكان أو زمان إقامة المهرجان، مثل in December أو in Riyadh. ولشرح طريقة الاحتفال نقول People celebrate by ثم نضيف الفعل مع ing. تذكّر أن الفعل بعد حرف الجر by يأخذ دائمًا ing.
examples: It takes place in February every year.
People celebrate by decorating their homes with lanterns.
Families celebrate by eating special food together.

words.ex: The streets are very busy in the morning.
The mall is always crowded at the weekend.
My grandmother's farm is very peaceful.
There is a lot of traffic in the city centre.
We go to the countryside in the holidays.
I love the fresh air in the village.

dialogue.t: Do you prefer living in the city or in a village?
I live in Jeddah. Life in the city is much busier than life in a village.
Yes, but there are more shops and parks in the city.
That's true. But villages are much more peaceful, and the air is fresher.
I visit my uncle's village every summer. It's much quieter than Riyadh.
So, would you rather live in the city or in a village?
I would rather live in the city because my friends are there. What about you?
I would rather live in a village. I love animals and nature!

grammar.title: Comparatives with much + I would rather
grammar.ar: نقارن بين شيئين باستخدام صيغة المقارنة مثل busier أو more peaceful ثم than. نضع much قبل صيغة المقارنة لنقول إن الفرق كبير جدًا. ونستخدم I would rather (أو I'd rather) ثم الفعل في صيغته الأصلية بدون to للتعبير عمّا نفضّله.
examples: Life in the city is much busier than life in a village.
The village is much more peaceful than the city.
I would rather live near the sea.

words.ex: Maybe I will drive a flying car one day.
Driverless buses might take us to school.
My uncle bought an electric car last year.
Electric cars make less pollution.
The fast train goes from Makkah to Madinah.
In the future, people might live on Mars.

dialogue.t: How do you think people will travel in fifty years?
I think cars might fly! We could fly over the traffic.
That would be amazing. I think we will probably have more driverless cars.
Yes, and most cars will probably be electric, so there will be less pollution.
Do you think people will travel to space for holidays?
Maybe. Rich people might go to the Moon, but I probably won't!
Ha ha! I will probably take a super fast train to visit my cousins.
Good idea. Trains will probably be much faster than today.

grammar.title: Predictions with will, will probably and might
grammar.ar: نستخدم will للتنبؤ بالمستقبل عندما نكون متأكدين تقريبًا. ونستخدم will probably عندما نكون متأكدين بنسبة كبيرة ولكن ليس تمامًا، وتأتي probably بعد will وقبل الفعل. أما might فتعني «ربما» ونستخدمها عندما نكون غير متأكدين. يأتي بعد will وmight الفعل في صيغته الأصلية دائمًا.
examples: Cars might fly in the future.
We will probably use electric buses.
People will probably not drive cars themselves.

words.ex: This school was built ten years ago.
The new museum was designed by a famous architect.
The old houses are made of mud and stone.
I want to be an architect when I grow up.
The Kingdom Tower in Riyadh is very tall.
We visited an ancient city in AlUla.

dialogue.t: Look at this photo. Do you know this building?
Yes! It's the Burj Khalifa in Dubai. It's the tallest building in the world.
When was it built?
It was built between 2004 and 2010. It was designed by an American architect, Adrian Smith.
Wow. What is it made of?
It is made of steel, glass and concrete.
Masmak Fort in Riyadh is very different. It is made of mud bricks.
Right! And it was built more than 150 years ago.

grammar.title: The passive: was built / is made of
grammar.ar: نستخدم المبني للمجهول (Passive) عندما يكون الشيء أهم من الشخص الذي قام بالفعل. يتكوّن من فعل be (is/are أو was/were) ثم التصريف الثالث للفعل مثل built وdesigned وmade. ونستخدم by لذكر من قام بالفعل، ونقول made of لذكر المادة المصنوع منها الشيء.
examples: The Eiffel Tower was built in 1889.
The pyramids are made of stone.
The Burj Khalifa was designed by Adrian Smith.

words.ex: I would like to travel abroad next summer.
We went sightseeing in London.
I bought a small souvenir for my mother.
I want to explore the mountains of Abha.
It is fun to try the local food when you travel.
My dream is to visit Japan.

dialogue.t: Can I ask you some questions about travel?
Of course! Go ahead.
Where would you like to go?
I would like to go to Japan.
Why?
Because I love Japanese cartoons, and I want to see the old temples and gardens.
What would you do there?
I would go sightseeing in Tokyo, try the local food and buy souvenirs for my family. What about you?

grammar.title: Would like to / What would you do?
grammar.ar: نستخدم would like to لنتحدث بأدب عن الأشياء التي نرغب في فعلها، ويأتي بعدها الفعل في صيغته الأصلية. ونستخدم What would you do? لنسأل عن موقف تخيّلي أو حلم، ونجيب بـ I would ثم الفعل. يمكن اختصار I would إلى I'd.
examples: Where would you like to go on holiday?
I would like to visit Egypt because I love history.
I would ride a camel and see the pyramids.

words.ex: The astronaut floated inside the space station.
The rocket went up into the sky very fast.
Mars is a red planet.
Astronauts live and work on the space station for months.
There is no gravity in space, so things float.
I would like to explore the Moon one day.

dialogue.t: Do you want to be an astronaut when you grow up?
Yes! I would like to go to Mars because it's a really interesting planet.
But it's hard work. Astronauts have to train for many years.
I know. They also have to eat special food in space.
And they have to sleep in sleeping bags on the wall!
That's funny. What about you? Where would you like to go?
I would like to visit the space station because I want to float with no gravity.
Cool! Maybe we can go together one day.

grammar.title: have to & would like to
grammar.ar: نستخدم have to + الفعل الأساسي للتعبير عن شيء ضروري أو واجب يجب فعله، مثل: Astronauts have to train. ومع he/she/it نقول has to. أما would like to + الفعل الأساسي فنستخدمها للتعبير عن رغبة أو أمنية بطريقة مهذبة، وتعني «أودّ أن». يمكننا إضافة because لنشرح السبب.
examples: Astronauts have to wear special suits outside the rocket.
She has to drink water from a bag in space.
I would like to see the Earth from space because it looks beautiful.

words.ex: Your heart beats faster when you run.
Our lungs take in air when we breathe.
Blood carries oxygen around the body.
We need milk to make our bones strong.
Our muscles help us move and jump.
The brain controls everything in the body.

dialogue.t: Can you put your hand on your chest? What can you feel?
My heart! It's beating fast. What does it do exactly?
The heart pumps blood around the body so that every part gets oxygen.
And where does the oxygen come from?
From the air. Our lungs take in air so that the blood can get oxygen.
Interesting! What do we need to stay healthy?
We need exercise to make our muscles strong, and we need sleep to rest our brain.
Then I need to go to bed early tonight!

grammar.title: Talking about purpose: to / so that
grammar.ar: نستخدم to + الفعل الأساسي لنشرح الهدف من شيء، وتعني «لكي». أما so that فيأتي بعدها جملة كاملة فيها فاعل وفعل، مثل: so that the blood can get oxygen. انتبه: لا نقول for to make، بل to make فقط.
examples: We need food to get energy.
The heart pumps blood so that our body gets oxygen.
We wear helmets to protect our brain.

words.ex: There was a big storm last night.
The thunder was so loud that my little brother cried.
We saw lightning in the dark sky.
The heavy rain caused a flood in the streets.
It was raining heavily all day.
Suddenly, the lights went out.

dialogue.t: Have you ever been in a really bad storm?
Yes! Last winter, it was raining heavily when we were driving home.
Oh no! What happened?
Suddenly the wind started to blow really hard, and we saw lightning everywhere.
Were you scared?
Very scared! Then the water in the street rose, and my dad stopped the car.
What did you do then?
We waited for an hour. Finally, the storm stopped and we got home safely.

grammar.title: Past continuous + past simple with when
grammar.ar: نستخدم الماضي المستمر (was/were + فعل ينتهي بـ ing) لوصف حدث طويل كان يحدث في الماضي، مثل: It was raining. ونستخدم الماضي البسيط لحدث قصير قطع الحدث الطويل، مثل: the wind started. نربط بينهما غالباً بكلمة when. كلمة suddenly تجعل القصة أكثر تشويقاً.
examples: It was raining heavily when we left school.
We were watching TV when the lights went out.
Suddenly the wind broke the window.

words.ex: Add some salt to the water.
Mix the water and the paint together.
Ice melts when it gets warm.
The egg floats in salty water.
I can see lots of bubbles in the glass.
Vinegar smells strong and tastes sour.

dialogue.t: Do you want to see a cool experiment?
Sure! What do we need?
Just baking soda, vinegar and a bottle. When you add vinegar to baking soda, it makes lots of bubbles.
Wow! Why does that happen?
It happens because they make a gas, so the bubbles grow very fast.
What happens when you put a balloon on the bottle?
The gas goes into the balloon, so it gets bigger and bigger!
That's amazing. Let's try it at school tomorrow!

grammar.title: Zero conditional with when + because / so
grammar.ar: نستخدم when + المضارع البسيط، ثم المضارع البسيط مرة أخرى، للحديث عن حقائق علمية تحدث دائماً، مثل: When you add salt, the egg floats. نستخدم because لنذكر السبب، ونستخدم so لنذكر النتيجة. تذكّر إضافة s للفعل مع he/she/it.
examples: When you heat ice, it melts.
The egg floats because salty water is heavy.
The gas goes into the balloon, so it gets bigger.

words.ex: Ibn al-Haytham was a famous scientist.
My grandfather was born in Cairo.
She discovered a new kind of medicine.
Who invented the telephone?
Light travels very fast.
The internet changed the world.

dialogue.t: Who is your favourite scientist?
Ibn al-Haytham. He was born in Basra, in Iraq, more than a thousand years ago.
What did he do?
He studied light and eyes. He discovered that we see things because light goes into our eyes.
Really? What did people think before?
Many people thought light came out of our eyes! He also did lots of experiments.
So how did his work help us?
It changed science. Later, people used his ideas to make cameras and glasses.

grammar.title: Past simple: regular and irregular verbs
grammar.ar: نستخدم الماضي البسيط للحديث عن أحداث انتهت في الماضي، مثل حياة عالِم. الأفعال المنتظمة نضيف لها ed، مثل: discover ← discovered. وهناك أفعال غير منتظمة يجب حفظها، مثل: make ← made، think ← thought. للحديث عن الولادة نقول دائماً was born وليس born فقط.
examples: He was born in Basra.
She discovered two new elements.
His ideas changed the world.

words.ex: Here's the next question for you.
That's correct! Well done.
Sorry, that answer is wrong.
Your team has ten points.
I don't know the answer, so I'll guess.
And the winner of today's quiz is Sara!

dialogue.t: Welcome to the Science Quiz Show! Are you ready?
Yes, I'm ready!
Great. Here's the first question: which planet is the closest to the Sun?
I think the answer is Mercury because it's the smallest and the hottest... no, wait, Mercury!
That's correct! You get ten points. Here's the next question: what does the heart pump?
I'm sure the answer is blood, because it carries oxygen around the body.
Correct again! Now you have twenty points. Last question: what happens when ice gets warm?
I think it melts because the heat changes it into water.

grammar.title: Giving answers with reasons: I think / I'm sure ... because
grammar.ar: عندما نجيب عن سؤال ولسنا متأكدين، نقول: I think the answer is... أو Maybe it's... وعندما نكون متأكدين نقول: I'm sure the answer is... ثم نضيف because لنشرح سبب الإجابة. هذا يجعل إجابتنا أقوى وأوضح.
examples: I think the answer is Mars because it's red.
I'm sure the answer is the brain because it controls the body.
Maybe it's lightning, but I'm not sure.

words.ex: I wrote a review of my favourite film for the school magazine.
My favourite character is the funny robot.
The car race in the film was really exciting.
I didn't like the ending because it was sad.
I recommend this film to all my friends.
The funniest scene was when the dog ate the cake.

dialogue.t: Have you seen any good films recently?
Yes! I watched The Lost Island last weekend.
What's it about?
It's about a girl who finds a secret map and goes on an adventure with her brother.
That sounds exciting! What was the best part?
The best part was when they found the treasure in a dark cave. The ending was amazing too.
Would you recommend it?
Yes, I recommend it because it's funny and exciting, and the characters are really brave.

grammar.title: Talking about films: present and past
grammar.ar: عندما نحكي قصة الفيلم نستخدم المضارع البسيط: It's about a girl who finds a map. وعندما نتحدث عن تجربتنا في مشاهدة الفيلم نستخدم الماضي البسيط: The best part was ... ونستخدم because لنعطي سببًا لرأينا أو لتوصيتنا.
examples: It's about a boy who can talk to animals.
The best part was the big race at the end.
I recommend it because it's very funny.

words.ex: Singing is my sister's special talent.
I practise the piano every evening.
The oud is a traditional Arabic instrument.
My drawing has improved a lot this year.
I feel more confident when I sing in front of my class.
I'm getting better at playing football.

dialogue.t: You play the guitar really well! How long have you been playing?
Thanks! I've been learning the guitar for two years.
Do you practise every day?
Almost. I practise for thirty minutes after school.
Is it difficult?
Sometimes, but I'm getting better at playing fast songs.
I've been learning to draw since last summer. I'm getting better at drawing faces.
That's great! Maybe you can design a poster for my band one day.

grammar.title: Present perfect continuous with for and since
grammar.ar: نستخدم المضارع التام المستمر (have/has been + فعل ينتهي بـ ing) للحديث عن نشاط بدأ في الماضي وما زال مستمرًا الآن. نستخدم for مع مدة زمنية مثل for two years، ونستخدم since مع نقطة بداية مثل since 2022. ونستخدم I'm getting better at + فعل ينتهي بـ ing لنقول إننا نتحسّن تدريجيًا.
examples: I've been learning the violin for three years.
She's been singing in the school choir since September.
I'm getting better at reading music.

words.ex: My favourite creator makes videos about animals.
This channel has videos about science for kids.
I subscribed to a cooking channel last week.
He uploads a new video every Friday.
I've watched every episode of this series.
Her channel has more than a million viewers.

dialogue.t: Do you watch videos online?
Yes, I've watched lots of videos by a creator called Chef Sami.
What are his videos like?
His videos are really useful because he shows easy recipes for kids.
Cool! I've watched every episode of a science channel called Fun Lab.
Why do you like it?
Their videos are exciting because they do safe experiments at home.
I've never seen it. I'll subscribe to it tonight!

grammar.title: Present perfect for experiences
grammar.ar: نستخدم المضارع التام (have/has + التصريف الثالث للفعل) للحديث عن تجاربنا في الحياة دون ذكر وقت محدد. نقول I've watched للإثبات، وI've never watched للنفي، ونسأل Have you ever watched...? وعندما نذكر وقتًا محددًا مثل yesterday نستخدم الماضي البسيط بدلًا منه.
examples: I've watched all of her videos about drawing.
Have you ever subscribed to a gaming channel?
Their videos are popular because they are really funny.

words.ex: I saw a funny advert for juice on TV.
This new product helps you keep your room tidy.
The shop gives every customer a free gift.
Try our new chocolate ice cream today!
There's a special offer: buy one, get one free!
This phone has an amazing camera.

dialogue.t: Are you tired of heavy school bags?
Yes! My back always hurts after school.
Then try the FlyBag! It's the lightest school bag in the world.
Wow! What else can it do?
It has a special pocket for your water bottle and a light for dark evenings.
How much is it?
This week there's a special offer: only twenty dollars! It's the best bag for students.
Amazing! Don't wait. Get your FlyBag today!

grammar.title: Imperatives and superlatives in adverts
grammar.ar: في الإعلانات نستخدم صيغة الأمر لنطلب من الناس فعل شيء، وتبدأ الجملة بالفعل مباشرة بدون فاعل مثل Try...! وBuy...! وللنفي نستخدم Don't مثل Don't wait! ونستخدم صيغة التفضيل العليا لنقول إن المنتج هو الأفضل: the + صفة + est مثل the lightest، أو the most + صفة طويلة مثل the most useful، والصيغة الشاذة the best.
examples: Are you tired of boring breakfasts? Try Crunchy Stars!
It's the best game for the whole family.
Don't miss our special offer. Buy it now!

words.ex: The reporter asked the football player some questions.
I watch the news with my dad every evening.
A witness saw the car hit the tree.
The headline said that our school won the competition.
The head teacher announced that there was no school on Sunday.
The reporter did an interview with the new mayor.

dialogue.t: Good evening. Here is today's news. There was a fire in a small shop on Park Street this morning.
Was anyone hurt?
No. A firefighter said that everyone was safe.
How did the fire start?
The shop owner told us that the fire started in the kitchen.
What did the witnesses say?
A woman said that she called the fire station very quickly. She told reporters that she was really scared.
Thank you for the report.

grammar.title: Reported speech with said and told
grammar.ar: نستخدم الكلام المنقول لنخبر الآخرين بما قاله شخص ما. نستخدم said that بدون مفعول به، أما told فيأتي بعده دائمًا شخص مثل told us أو told me. وعادةً نرجع زمن الفعل خطوة إلى الماضي: is تصبح was، وcan تصبح could، وwill تصبح would.
examples: The man said that he was very happy.
He told us that the match was cancelled.
The reporter said that the new park would open next week.

words.ex: The host of the show is very funny.
Tonight's guest is a famous footballer.
The audience laughed at his joke.
I felt nervous before my first concert.
My parents were proud when I won the prize.
Everyone clapped at the end of the song.

dialogue.t: Welcome to the show! Today our guest is Lina, the young singer. Hello, Lina!
Hello! Thank you for having me.
Tell us about your first song.
I wrote it when I was nine. It's about my grandmother.
How did you feel when you sang on stage for the first time?
I felt really nervous, but the audience clapped and I felt proud.
What are your plans for the future?
I'm making a new album. It will come out next year!

grammar.title: Interview questions in the past simple
grammar.ar: لنسأل عن أحداث في الماضي نستخدم كلمة استفهام ثم did ثم الفاعل ثم الفعل في صيغته الأساسية، مثل How did you feel...? وليس How did you felt. ونستخدم Tell us about... لنطلب من الضيف أن يتحدث بالتفصيل عن موضوع ما. وعند الإجابة نستخدم الفعل في الماضي البسيط مثل I felt...
examples: Welcome to the show! Tell us about your new film.
How did you feel when you won the competition?
When did you start playing the piano?

lessons: Practise starting and keeping a conversation
Nice to meet you. What do you like doing? Me too! / Really?
I felt nervous when ... I was excited because ...
Give suggestions to solve a friend problem
Why don't you ...? You could ... Maybe you should ...
Share kind things you have done
I have helped ... I've never ... but I want to ...
Talk about working in a team
We worked together to ... My job was to ...
Ask for and give advice in different situations
If I were you, I would ... You ought to ...
In Japan people usually ..., but in Saudi Arabia we ...
It takes place in ... People celebrate by ...
Compare city life and village life
Life in the city is much busier than ... I would rather ...
Cars might fly ... We will probably ...
It was built in ... It is made of ... It was designed by ...
Where would you like to go? Why? What would you do there?
Astronauts have to ... I would like to ... because ...
Explain how parts of the body work
The heart pumps ... so that ... We need ... to ...
Tell a story about extreme weather
It was raining heavily when ... Suddenly the wind ...
Explain an experiment with cause and effect
When you add ..., it ... because ... so ...
He was born in ... He discovered ... It changed ...
Host and answer a quiz show
Here's the next question ... I think the answer is ... because ...
Review a film and recommend it
It's about ... The best part was ... I recommend it because ...
I've been learning ... for ... I'm getting better at ...
I've watched ... Their videos are ... because ...
Are you tired of ...? Try ...! It's the best ...
The man said that ... He told us that ...
Welcome to the show! Tell us about ... How did you feel when ...?
